s.how: Bake a meatloaf from 400g beef mince, 1 egg and breadcrumbs at 180C for 45 minutes. Cool, slice and make sandwiches on buttered bread with tomato sauce.

s.note: game day tailgating at Notre Dame
s.how: Grill 8 bratwurst for 12 minutes, turning. Fry 2 sliced onions until soft and golden. Serve in 8 rolls with the onions and mustard. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Brown a 1.5kg chuck roast, add 750ml stock and braise covered at 160C for 3 hours. Add 3 carrots and 800g potatoes for the last hour.

w.how: Slice 5 green apples into a dish. Rub 100g butter into 120g flour and 100g brown sugar, scatter on top and bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Serve with cream.

d.how: Chill 1L milk and pour into 4 tall glasses. Serve with 200g plain biscuits on a plate. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
